weaknesses.text: The low roof and small windows reduce outward visibility in the sixth-generation coupe.

maintenanceAccessibility.text: The long-term test gives one example of ordinary service and tire replacement. Shop rates and unexpected repairs remain variable.

driving.text: The V8 and accurate chassis make it unusually engaging for its size. Its poor sightlines still demand adjustment.

styling.text: A narrow waist and broad shoulders give the SS a purposeful stance, with tall doors adding visual weight.

character.enthusiastAppeal: The Alpha chassis combines muscle-car proportions with precise placement.
character.idealBuyer: A driver who wants a manual coupe and can live with limited sightlines.
character.avoidIf: You need good outward visibility or regularly carry rear passengers.
